b: With the Black Friday tool deals season in full swing, it’s expected that Harbor Freight would make a big showing with bargains and gift ideas.
Let’s take a peek at the official Harbor Freight Black Friday 2026 sales flyer! You can thank Lauren for the legwork on this one.
The deals kick off for the public on 11/26/26, and end 11/30. Inside Track Club subscribers get a 3-day head start, with the deals opening to them on 11/23.
As usual, there are some steep discounts on popular Harbor Freight tool brands. New for this year is a deal on ALL US General tool storage cabinets and carts.
Also note that these percent-off deals are in-store only.

US General Storage Cabinets and Carts – 25% off
Braun Lighting – 40% off
ICON Ratchets (Individual Sizes) – 40% off
Hardy Work Gloves – 50% off
Badland Winches and Accessories – 35% off
The ICON bit ratchet set, also known online as the “meme tool,” will be discounted from $40 to $28. There’s also a discount on the ICON magnetic tool mat.
US General mini tool boxes will be $15 each, or $17 for limited edition colors.
Buy a Bauer cordless power tool starter kit for $100, get a free tool from 7 options.
Select Predator generators are also featured in the sales flyer.
The Yukon 46-inch 9-drawer mobile storage cabinet will be $290, and it looks like there are 5 colors (blue, red, grey, white, black).
The Daytona 3-ton low-profile floor jack will be $220. There are plenty of jack stand options as well, even in matching colors.
There are some air tools and compact compressors.
Cordless and AC power tools. Benchtop belt and disc combo sander for $90.
You can save a bit on select Bauer tool boxes.
Some Hercules tools are also on sale, although I expected a bit more. Maybe we’ll see some last-minute doorbuster deals.

I remember a conversation I had with a Harbor Freight employee a few years ago, right around this time of year. They said that Black Friday was not a big sale for them, and didn’t compare to the foot traffic they saw for Labor Day. I wonder if things have changed.
There are plenty more deals at HF and elsewhere. What are you shopping for at Harbor Freight this season?
